assertions.title: Registration toggle controls both UI affordance and registration API

steps.action: PUT /api/admin/settings registrationEnabled=false, then GET /api/config
steps.expected: /api/config shows registrationEnabled=false
steps.observed: registrationEnabled=false confirmed in round3-ui-registration-disable.json and round3-api-auth-model-admin-results.json

steps.action: Open /login in browser after disabling registration
steps.expected: Sign-up affordance hidden
steps.observed: Login page showed only Email/Password/Continue (no Sign up link) in VAL-AUTH-001-login-after-disable.png

steps.action: Open /register directly after disabling registration
steps.expected: Redirect or disabled-registration state
steps.observed: Full registration form remained accessible (VAL-AUTH-001-register-after-disable.png)

steps.action: POST /api/auth/register without invite token while disabled
steps.expected: 403 with "Registration is not allowed."
steps.observed: 403 with {"message":"Registration is not allowed."}

steps.action: Create valid invite token + POST /api/auth/register with token while disabled
steps.expected: Invite signup still allowed
steps.observed: Invite registration returned 200 and invited user login succeeded

evidence.network: GET /api/config -> registrationEnabled=false; POST /api/auth/register (no invite) -> 403; POST /api/auth/register (invite token) -> 200

assertions.issues: /register still renders the full registration form when registration is disabled.

assertions.title: SUPERADMIN_EMAILS auto-promotes matching users on startup and auth flows

steps.action: Check SUPERADMIN_EMAILS env in dev API container
steps.expected: Allowlist configured and includes validation superadmin email
steps.observed: Env reported SET and contained val-superadmin@dev.local

steps.action: PATCH val-superadmin role to USER
steps.expected: Demotion applies before auth-flow retest
steps.observed: PATCH succeeded with role USER

steps.action: Re-login val-superadmin
steps.expected: Allowlisted auth flow auto-promotes back to ADMIN
steps.observed: Re-login returned role ADMIN

steps.action: GET /api/admin/permissions after re-login
steps.expected: isSuperAdmin=true
steps.observed: 200 with isSuperAdmin=true and superadmin permissions

evidence.network: PATCH /api/admin/users/{superadminId} -> 200; POST /api/auth/login -> 200 role ADMIN; GET /api/admin/permissions -> 200 isSuperAdmin=true

assertions.title: New non-admin users receive the documented default model allowlist

steps.action: Create fresh local non-admin account via /api/auth/register and login first session
steps.expected: Documented default allowlist (README: openAI gpt-5.1, google gemini-3-flash-preview+gemini-2.5-flash-lite, ollama all)
steps.observed: Fresh local user received broader defaults (openAI gpt-5.4 mini/nano + anthropic + azureOpenAI + xAI + ollama)

steps.action: Invite-signup non-admin while registration disabled, then first login
steps.expected: Same documented default restricted allowlist
steps.observed: Invited user also received broader defaults matching local registration (not documented default list)

steps.action: Compare with superadmin catalog
steps.expected: Admin remains unrestricted
steps.observed: Superadmin /api/models retained full multi-provider catalog

steps.action: Check federated/auto-provisioned path availability
steps.expected: At least one federated path testable for parity
steps.observed: All social/federated login flags were false in /api/config, so federated branch was unavailable in this environment

evidence.network: POST /api/auth/register (local) -> 200; POST /api/auth/login (fresh local/invited) -> 200; GET /api/models (fresh users) -> 200 with broader non-documented defaults

assertions.issues: Observed first-login non-admin model defaults do not match the documented default allowlist; federated path was also unavailable (all social flags disabled).

assertions.title: Model restrictions are enforced server-side across config, chat, agents, and assistants

steps.action: Restrict val-user modelPermissions to openAI:gpt-5.1 and fetch /api/models + /api/config
steps.expected: Filtered model visibility in both config/models surfaces
steps.observed: /api/models filtered correctly to openAI:gpt-5.1 and other endpoints empty; config fetched under restricted session

steps.action: Probe blocked model on assistants surface (/api/assistants/v1/chat with gpt-5.4)
steps.expected: Blocked model rejected with model-access error
steps.observed: Received event error "Illegal model request"

steps.action: Probe blocked model on agents surface (/api/agents/chat/openAI with gpt-5.4)
steps.expected: Blocked model explicitly rejected server-side
steps.observed: Returned stream start payload (conversation started); no conclusive model-access rejection captured in this run

steps.action: Restore original val-user modelPermissions
steps.expected: State cleanup completed
steps.observed: Restore PATCH returned 200

evidence.network: PATCH modelPermissions restrict/restore -> 200; GET /api/models restricted -> 200 filtered; POST /api/assistants/v1/chat blocked -> event error Illegal model request; POST /api/agents/chat/openAI blocked -> stream started response

assertions.issues: Could not conclusively verify the full chat+agents+assistants enforcement matrix in this pass; agent blocked-model probe did not yield a definitive model-access denial artifact.

assertions.title: Registration gating, super-admin sync, and default model restrictions stay aligned

steps.action: Disable registration, then run invite signup flow
steps.expected: Invite signup remains functional while direct signup is blocked
steps.observed: Direct register returned 403; invite-based register returned 200 and user could login

steps.action: Check invited user first authenticated model catalog
steps.expected: Immediate default restricted model list alignment
steps.observed: Invited user first-session model catalog was broader than documented default restrictions

steps.action: Validate allowlisted superadmin behavior in same session
steps.expected: Allowlisted user isSuperAdmin=true with unrestricted catalog
steps.observed: val-superadmin permissions 200 with isSuperAdmin=true and unrestricted /api/models catalog

evidence.network: POST /api/auth/register direct->403, invite->200; GET /api/admin/permissions superadmin->200 isSuperAdmin=true; GET /api/models invited user->broader defaults

assertions.issues: Invite path and superadmin sync both worked, but ordinary invited-user first-session model restrictions were not aligned with documented defaults.

assertions.title: Realtime provider discovery is auth-gated, credential-aware, and resilient to stale websocket query tokens

steps.action: GET /api/realtime/models unauthenticated and authenticated
steps.expected: 401 unauth + authenticated provider metadata with availability/credential reasons
steps.observed: Unauth 401; superadmin 200 with providers including available/requiresUserKey/reason fields; restricted user returned providers: []

steps.action: WebSocket stale token probes (with and without same-origin cookies)
steps.expected: Stale token alone rejected; stale token with valid cookie falls back to session auth
steps.observed: stale token no cookie -> 401; stale token + superadmin cookie -> websocket opened and session.started succeeded

steps.action: Provider-specific session starts
steps.expected: OpenAI start succeeds with configured transcription; unavailable providers rejected explicitly
steps.observed: OpenAI start succeeded via stale-cookie fallback; user blocked-model probe returned explicit unavailable-model error; Azure/xAI starts returned explicit credential-required errors

steps.action: Azure credentialed GA URL/deployment mapping branch
steps.expected: Azure credentialed start path validated
steps.observed: Blocked by missing Azure user credentials/base URL in assigned dev environment

evidence.network: /api/realtime/models: 401 unauth, 200 auth; WS: stale token 401 without cookie, session.start accepted with cookie fallback, explicit provider errors for unavailable/credential-missing starts

assertions.issues: Core auth-gating and stale-token cookie fallback passed, but Azure credentialed provider-specific connect branch could not be executed in this isolation environment.

assertions.title: Native web search exposes inline stream status instead of silent backend-only activity

steps.action: Run web-search-capable chat turn on gpt-4o-search-preview and capture during-stream UI
steps.expected: Inline status part shows "Searching the web…" while search is in progress
steps.observed: No inline "Searching the web" status visible in during-stream capture

steps.action: Run explicit UI text wait for "Searching the web"
steps.expected: Status text appears at least once during active stream
steps.observed: wait --text timed out; FOUND_SEARCHING_STATUS=false

steps.action: Capture completed response output
steps.expected: Search-backed response finishes cleanly with sources
steps.observed: Completed response included source-linked output (theguardian.com links) but still no inline searching status evidence

evidence.network: POST /api/agents/chat/openAI + stream route observed in browser-network-final.txt; status-text probe timed out

assertions.issues: Inline "Searching the web…" stream status was not observed; explicit text wait timed out despite source-linked completion output.

assertions.title: Reasoning and grounded-source presentation remains merged and source-linked

steps.action: Verify grounded/source-linked presentation using web-search response output
steps.expected: Grounded output maps to inline citations/source links in existing UI
steps.observed: Source-linked response content rendered with external citation links (e.g., theguardian.com) in chat output

steps.action: Run reasoning-oriented prompts on gpt-5.4 and o3 and inspect for Thoughts block behavior
steps.expected: Reasoning chunks appear as coherent merged Thoughts block
steps.observed: No explicit Thoughts block/chunk-merge UI surfaced; outputs appeared as normal text/step-by-step content

steps.action: Capture during/after screenshots for reasoning attempts
steps.expected: Visual evidence of reasoning UI state
steps.observed: Captured reasoning attempts but no dedicated Thoughts block was present in screenshots/text snapshots

evidence.network: Reasoning turns executed via /api/agents/chat/openAI stream routes in browser-network-final.txt

assertions.issues: Grounded/source-linked output was observed, but Thoughts chunk-merge behavior remained unobservable in tested prompts/models.

frictions.description: Realtime API/WS probe pass initially hit login 429 throttles after earlier auth-heavy checks.
frictions.resolution: Reran approved anti-abuse reset (dev-seed-validation-personas.js + docker restart librechat-dev-api + wait) and retried probes successfully.

frictions.description: Tools popup and selector overlays intermittently blocked click targets during browser flow.
frictions.resolution: Used Escape to dismiss overlays and re-snapshot refs before continuing.

frictions.description: Model selector requires filtering in combobox and selecting option rows; endpoint list and model list share the same popover and caused initial mis-targeted clicks.
frictions.resolution: Filtered selector input explicitly (gpt-4o-search-preview, gpt-5.4, o3), selected concrete option refs, then verified chosen model labels via get text.

blockers.description: Federated/auto-provisioned login path unavailable in this dev isolation (all social/federated login flags false in /api/config).
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Confirmed config flags in round3-api-auth-model-admin-results.json; no in-scope credentials/config to enable federated flow.

blockers.description: Azure realtime credentialed branch unavailable (requires user key + base URL).
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Executed azure session.start probe; received explicit "requires both an API key and base URL" error.

blockers.description: Full agents/chat/assistants blocked-model enforcement matrix did not produce conclusive agents-surface denial evidence in this pass.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Captured restricted /api/models + assistants blocked-model denial + agent blocked probe response, then restored modelPermissions to baseline.

blockers.description: Reasoning Thoughts chunk stream did not surface as dedicated Thoughts UI block in tested prompts/models.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Retested with both gpt-5.4 and o3 reasoning prompts and captured during/after evidence; only plain text reasoning output appeared.

summary: Retested 8 assigned assertions on dev rail: 1 pass (VAL-ADMIN-003), 4 fail (VAL-AUTH-001, VAL-MODEL-001, VAL-CROSS-001, VAL-REALTIME-004), and 3 blocked (VAL-MODEL-003, VAL-REALTIME-002, VAL-REALTIME-005). Temporary mutations (registration toggle, model-permissions changes, temporary users) were restored/cleaned up, and post-run state confirms registrationEnabled=true with val-superadmin restored as ADMIN.
